caption: The video showcases an indoor rug-cleaning workshop where a rectangular, shaggy beige rug lies partly saturated with white soapy foam on a large white tarp. A person wearing white rubber boots and dark trousers stands at the far end of the rug, gripping a long-handled tool with a flat metal head. Throughout the excerpt the metal head translates steadily down the length of the rug, moving from near its far edge toward the camera while the operator's boots remain roughly in place. A mound of white suds gathers at the leading edge of the head and travels with it, leaving the strip the head has passed comparatively clearer and more beige than the foamy region ahead. The long handle shifts from nearly vertical to a more diagonal angle as the head advances. A pool of foam and water fills the foreground below the rug, showing only minor surface ripples. A blue air-mover fan, cleaning machines, bottles and a red cone stay fixed in the background beneath a 'MOUNTAIN RUG CLEANING' logo. The camera remains static, capturing this single pass of the tool without showing how it began or where it ends.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness

prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
